The overall odds of winning Powerball Xs & Os are approximately 1 in 12.16.

Official pari-mutuel prize payouts for the September 13, 2026 Powerball Xs & Os drawing are available at www.powerball.com/xo.

Powerball Xs & Os results are randomly drawn and not based on, determined by, or dependent on the outcome of NFL games.

*If other tickets also match all eight teams, the prize pool will be split into equal amounts among all winning tickets. Lower-tier prizes may become pari-mutuel in some circumstances.

**Sales stop on draw nights at 5:59 PM Arizona time from the second Sunday in March through the first Saturday in November and at 6:59 PM Arizona time from the first Sunday in November through the second Saturday in March.

***Lottery results broadcasted on television or radio, published on the Arizona State Lottery website, or published and/or communicated by other means does not constitute an official representation of the actual winning team logos. The Arizona State Lottery official audited records of teams drawn will determine the winning team logos for any draw. A draw game prize must be claimed within 180 days of a drawing.

All sales are final. Drawing game tickets cannot be voided.

howToPlay:
HOW TO PLAY
POWERBALL XS & OS
Step 1,
Pick Your Team Logos

Choose Quick Pick and let the computer select 8 team logos from a set of 32, or select your own.

Step 2,
Buy Your Ticket

Powerball Xs & Os tickets cost $5 per game and can be purchased** at more than 3,600 Arizona Lottery Retailers.

Step 3,
Check Your Winnings

After the drawing occurs, match the team logos on your ticket to the winning team logos*** selected to see if you won.
